caption: The drawing is a colored map of New York State, showing state boundaries, counties, major water bodies, and locations of glass factories. The land area is depicted in tan or beige, with county borders marked by dashed black lines and county names in uppercase black letters. Major water bodies, Lake Erie and Lake Ontario, are colored in light blue, with their names written in larger, stylized blue script. A red line traverses several counties from west to east, likely indicating a major route, with smaller red dots and numbers next to specific towns or cities marking the locations of glass factories. These numbered locations correspond to a list in the lower left labeled "Locations of Glass Factories," which provides the names and years of operation for each site; the list is in black text with the numbers in red. There are a few blue pictorial icons of glass factories scattered across the map, aligning with the red-dotted factory sites. The map also features a decorative black-and-red compass rose in the lower right corner. The title "NEW YORK STATE" appears near the top left in black uppercase letters, with the word "New" in a stylized script. The map is enclosed in a double-line border.
title: Map of New York State
